info.title: skolia API
info.description: The API behind skolia.io's reader. Sign in on the reader, and the requests Scalar's page (/api/scalar) tries carry your session cookie. Lists come a page at a time: pass a page's next as ?after= for the page after it. Every offset into a text is in UTF-16 code units, a JavaScript string index. The lexicon is its own API, served under /api/lexicon/ (its spec at /api/lexicon/v1/openapi.json).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Only skolia's own accounts have keys: the end-to-end tests' and the curated texts'

IsoTime.description: An ISO 8601 UTC time, any precision

FeatureSets.description: The feature sets a response's paradigms use, by id: { "50": { Case: "Gen", ... } }. An id means something only within its language's loaded lexicon.

id.description: The text's: the same text imported twice in one language is one document.

author.description: Who wrote the text, as the uploader gives it.

source.description: An http(s) URL of where the text is from.

importer.description: The entry's user: with id, the summary is one (document, user) pair.

mine.description: Whether it's the viewer's entry, so they can change or delete it.

queue.description: Where it is in its language's analysis queue: for the viewer's own document, while it's queued or analysing, when it's asked for on its own.

reading.description: The analysis to show by name (GET .../analysis/{name}). While an update is pending or failed, the previous analysis stays available.

DocumentSummary.description: One user's entry for a text: the viewer's own, or someone's public one. Its title, visibility, licence, author and source are that user's.

QueuePlace.description: starting: the language's analyser is starting, its container booting or its model loading. ahead: how many texts it analyses before this one, the one it's analysing included; null when it hasn't been handed this one yet.

recent.description: The jobs started most recently, newest first, but those an analyser is running.

loading.description: Whether it's still loading its models; jobs wait till it's done.

jobs.description: Running, then waiting, in the order they run.

IngestedDocument.description: The text, with the title the viewer sees; null for one the viewer can't see.

image.description: The analysis image that ran it.

result.description: Null for a job that started and hasn't finished, and that no analyser is running: its container stopped first, or its result is on its way. The error is null for a text the viewer can't see.

stages.description: The stages it ran, in order, the one it failed in included.

IngestOutcome.description: retried: storage failed and the job went back in line, to run again as another job.
